entries.title: James 5:1
segments: ¶Go to now, ye rich, weep, howling over your miseries that [are] coming upon [you].

entries.title: James 5:2
segments: Your wealth is become rotten, and your garments moth-eaten.

entries.title: James 5:3
segments: Your gold and silver is eaten away, and their canker shall be for a witness against you, and shall eat your flesh as fire. Ye have heaped up treasure in [the] last days.

entries.title: James 5:4
segments: Behold, the wages of your labourers, who have harvested your fields, wrongfully kept back by you, cry, and the cries of those that have reaped are entered into the ears of [the] Lord of sabaoth.

entries.title: James 5:5
segments: Ye have lived luxuriously on the earth and indulged yourselves; ye have nourished your hearts [as] in a day of slaughter;

entries.title: James 5:6
segments: ye have condemned, ye have killed the just; he does not resist you.

entries.title: James 5:7
segments: Have patience, therefore, brethren, till the coming of the Lord. Behold, the labourer awaits the precious fruit of the earth, having patience for it until it receive [the] early and [the] latter rain.

entries.title: James 5:8
segments: *Ye* also have patience: stablish your hearts, for the coming of the Lord is drawn nigh.

entries.title: James 5:9
segments: Complain not one against another, brethren, that ye be not judged. Behold, the judge stands before the door.

entries.title: James 5:10
segments: Take [as] an example, brethren, of suffering and having patience, the prophets, who have spoken in the name of [the] Lord.

entries.title: James 5:11
segments: Behold, we call them blessed who have endured. Ye have heard of the endurance of Job, and seen the end of the Lord; that the Lord is full of tender compassion and pitiful.

entries.title: James 5:12
segments: ¶But before all things, my brethren, swear not, neither by heaven, nor by the earth, nor by any other oath; but let your yea be yea, and your nay, nay, that ye do not fall under judgment.

entries.title: James 5:13
segments: Does any one among you suffer evil? let him pray. Is any happy? let him sing psalms.

entries.title: James 5:14
segments: Is any sick among you? let him call to [him] the elders of the assembly, and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of [the] Lord;

entries.title: James 5:15
segments: and the prayer of faith shall heal the sick, and the Lord shall raise him up; and if he be one who has committed sins, it shall be forgiven him.

entries.title: James 5:16
segments: Confess therefore your offences to one another, and pray for one another, that ye may be healed. [The] fervent supplication of the righteous [man] has much power.

entries.title: James 5:17
segments: Elias was a man of like passions to us, and he prayed with prayer that it should not rain; and it did not rain upon the earth three years and six months;

entries.title: James 5:18
segments: and again he prayed, and the heaven gave rain, and the earth caused its fruit to spring forth.

entries.title: James 5:19
segments: My brethren, if any one among you err from the truth, and one bring him back,

entries.title: James 5:20
segments: let him know that he that brings back a sinner from [the] error of his way shall save a soul from death and shall cover a multitude of sins.
